evidence.claim: Jokowi ordered a thorough investigation into the Kanjuruhan tragedy, said sanctions should be imposed on those guilty, and directed relevant ministries and the National Police to investigate and reveal the perpetrators.
evidence.title: President Jokowi Orders Thorough Investigation on Kanjuruhan Tragedy
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi ordered a thorough investigation into the Kanjuruhan tragedy, said sanctions should be imposed on those guilty, and directed relevant ministries and the National Police to investigate and reveal the perpetrators.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct presidential statement published the same day by the Cabinet Secretariat.
evidence.period_fit: Immediate 2022 response to a deadly domestic security failure.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Jokowi order and supervisory response.
contrary_evidence: The order is remedial rather than preventive.
It does not itself establish effective accountability or reform.

evidence.claim: Jokowi ordered the independent fact-finding team to disclose its findings within one month and the government issued a presidential decree to support the investigation.
evidence.title: President Jokowi Orders Kanjuruhan Fact-finding Team to Reveal Investigation Results in One Month
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi ordered the independent fact-finding team to disclose its findings within one month and the government issued a presidential decree to support the investigation.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official transcript of Jokowi's directive and the government's response.
evidence.period_fit: Immediate follow-up to the Kanjuruhan disaster in 2022.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Jokowi directive via the Cabinet Secretariat report.
contrary_evidence: A fast investigation does not guarantee independent or complete accountability.
The article does not show the eventual legal outcome.

evidence.claim: The fact-finding team handed Jokowi a 124-page report that identified legal and moral responsibility and recommended that police continue criminal investigations of suspected persons responsible for the tragedy.
evidence.title: Kanjuruhan Fact-Finding Team Reports Results of Investigation to President Jokowi
evidence.excerpt: The fact-finding team handed Jokowi a 124-page report that identified legal and moral responsibility and recommended that police continue criminal investigations of suspected persons responsible for the tragedy.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official record of the team briefing the president and summarizing the report's conclusions.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct report to Jokowi and presidential oversight of the response.
contrary_evidence: Recommendation and reporting are not the same as completed justice.
The article does not indicate whether recommendations were fully implemented.

evidence.claim: Komnas HAM concluded that police tear gas was the main trigger for the Kanjuruhan stampede, said the police fired tear gas 45 times, and noted the disaster killed 135 people including children.
evidence.title: Police use of tear gas triggered Kanjuruhan stampede: Komnas HAM
evidence.excerpt: Komnas HAM concluded that police tear gas was the main trigger for the Kanjuruhan stampede, said the police fired tear gas 45 times, and noted the disaster killed 135 people including children.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous report of Komnas HAM's public findings with specific casualty and force details.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 fact finding about a major domestic protection failure.
evidence.ruler_attribution: The abuse was committed by security forces under Jokowi's national administration, not by Jokowi personally.
contrary_evidence: The article reports institutional findings rather than a direct presidential order.
It captures a single disaster, not the whole year.

evidence.claim: Amnesty said the Wadas quarry operation was tied to a dam Jokowi had designated a national strategic project, and that hundreds of security personnel entering the village caused fear, with videos showing arbitrary detentions and beatings of residents.
evidence.title: Indonesia: End harassment of residents opposed to 'national strategic project'
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said the Wadas quarry operation was tied to a dam Jokowi had designated a national strategic project, and that hundreds of security personnel entering the village caused fear, with videos showing arbitrary detentions and beatings of residents.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Detailed contemporaneous human-rights reporting with resident video corroboration and explicit ruler attribution for the project.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 domestic protest and land-rights confrontation.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Jokowi's project designation and the security deployment make the issue ruler-relevant, though local police/tactical units carried out the abuse.
contrary_evidence: The article is advocacy-oriented and does not establish a direct presidential order to use force.
The project itself is not evidence of violence absent the security response.

evidence.claim: Amnesty reported that on 12 February 2022 police shot dead 21-year-old Erfaldi during a protest against a gold-mining operation, using tear gas and live ammunition to disperse hundreds of people; a police-officer trial was still ongoing at year's end.
evidence.title: Amnesty International Report 2022/23; The State of the World's Human Rights; Indonesia 2022
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty reported that on 12 February 2022 police shot dead 21-year-old Erfaldi during a protest against a gold-mining operation, using tear gas and live ammunition to disperse hundreds of people; a police-officer trial was still ongoing at year's end.
evidence.source_locator: report section on unlawful killings and excessive use of force
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Annual rights report summarizing 2022 events with a specific death, method, and accountability status.
evidence.period_fit: 2022 domestic protest policing and lethal force.
evidence.ruler_attribution: The killing was by police under Jokowi's national administration; the report does not show Jokowi personally ordered the shooting.
contrary_evidence: One incident does not prove a nationwide terror system.
The ongoing trial indicates some accountability, though limited.

evidence.claim: Amnesty said Indigenous Papuans protesting the creation of new autonomous regions were met with obstruction and excessive force, including a student held at gunpoint and beaten unconscious, with at least 36 other protesters injured.
evidence.title: Repeated excessive use of force against peaceful protests show disregard for Papuan voices
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said Indigenous Papuans protesting the creation of new autonomous regions were met with obstruction and excessive force, including a student held at gunpoint and beaten unconscious, with at least 36 other protesters injured.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous human-rights reporting with specific injuries and protest details.
evidence.ruler_attribution: The abuses were by Indonesian police and fall within Jokowi's national oversight, though the article does not show a direct presidential order.
contrary_evidence: The incident is regionally concentrated and does not establish national-scale terror.
The article is advocacy-oriented and should be read with its human-rights framing in mind.

evidence.claim: Amnesty said Indonesian authorities made 116 arrests and injured at least 17 people during forced dispersals of rallies in West Papua, including arrests before some rallies had even started.
evidence.title: Mass arrests and forced dispersals in West Papua on Human Rights Day
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said Indonesian authorities made 116 arrests and injured at least 17 people during forced dispersals of rallies in West Papua, including arrests before some rallies had even started.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Specific contemporaneous reporting with a clear tally of arrests and injuries.
evidence.period_fit: Late-2022 domestic protest suppression in Papua.
evidence.ruler_attribution: The arrests were made by Indonesian authorities under Jokowi's administration, but the article does not isolate a presidential command.
contrary_evidence: The piece documents protest suppression, not a full account of later prosecutions or remedies.
It is focused on West Papua and does not describe the whole country.

evidence.claim: Military police detained six army soldiers suspected in the murder of four residents in Mimika, and the army said it would seriously investigate and impose strict sanctions on the perpetrators.
evidence.title: Military police detains six suspects in Mimika murder case
evidence.excerpt: Military police detained six army soldiers suspected in the murder of four residents in Mimika, and the army said it would seriously investigate and impose strict sanctions on the perpetrators.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous report of arrests and official military response with concrete custody details.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 security-force abuse and accountability response in Papua.
evidence.ruler_attribution: The perpetrators were military personnel under Jokowi's national government; the response was institutional rather than personal.
contrary_evidence: Arrests do not erase the underlying abuse.
The article does not show why the killings occurred or whether all responsible parties were prosecuted.

evidence.claim: HRW said military and police abused rights across Indonesia with impunity, especially in Papua and West Papua, and that President Jokowi did little to stand up for rights during the year.
evidence.title: World Report 2023: Indonesia
evidence.excerpt: HRW said military and police abused rights across Indonesia with impunity, especially in Papua and West Papua, and that President Jokowi did little to stand up for rights during the year.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Major annual NGO assessment synthesizing 2022 trends and ruler-level posture.
evidence.period_fit: Summarizes the full 2022 year in the target ruler period.
evidence.ruler_attribution: HRW's assessment is directly about the Jokowi administration, not a single incident.
contrary_evidence: This is a synthesis rather than a single event record.
The report is critical and should be balanced against the government's investigative responses.

evidence.claim: Police fired tear gas and water cannon at students protesting cooking oil prices and a mooted extension of Jokowi's stay in office; Jokowi later urged ministers and security chiefs to stop discussing the extension.
evidence.title: Indonesia police fire tear gas to disperse protest at parliament
evidence.excerpt: Police fired tear gas and water cannon at students protesting cooking oil prices and a mooted extension of Jokowi's stay in office; Jokowi later urged ministers and security chiefs to stop discussing the extension.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting republished by Euronews with contemporaneous protest details and presidential response.
evidence.period_fit: Direct April 2022 protest policing and term-extension controversy.
evidence.ruler_attribution: The protest response was by police under Jokowi's national administration; Jokowi's own statement was to dampen extension speculation.
contrary_evidence: The article does not show Jokowi ordered the tear gas.
The protest included some non-peaceful elements, so the policing context is mixed.
